name: Ann Arbor lifeguard certification course and pool jobs
org: City of Ann Arbor Parks and Recreation (Mack Indoor Pool)
what_you_do: Take the American Red Cross lifeguard course (lifeguarding, first aid, CPR and AED). If you are hired at one of the city's pools, the $200 course fee is refunded. The city also hires seasonal staff at pools, golf courses and canoe liveries.
who_can_apply: The course is open to ages 15 and up. The page says you are prepared to be a lifeguard when you turn 16. Fifteen year olds who finish the course can join the city's Lifeguard in Training Volunteer Program.
pay_detail: Course fee $200, fully refunded if you pass, apply, are hired and start work at a city pool. Pay for pool jobs is not stated on the pages read.
duration: Weekend course: Friday evening, Saturday and Sunday
deadline_text: Registration for the course opens Jan 21, 2027. Session 1 starts Friday, April 16, 2027 (Friday 5 to 10 p.m., then Saturday and Sunday 11 a.m. to 7:30 p.m.). Registration closes 7 days before the course starts. Seasonal job postings for 2027 are not up yet.
how_to_apply: Register for the course by calling 734-794-6237 or at Mack Indoor Pool (715 Brooks St., inside Ann Arbor Open School). Pool jobs are applied for online through the city's job board when posted.
notes: The lifeguard certification page says 15 year olds can join the Lifeguard in Training Volunteer Program. The recertification section says 15 year olds can be eligible for a city lifeguard job. These two statements differ. Ask the pool at 734-794-6237 what age you can be hired. Michigan says minors must get a work permit before starting a job unless exempt. The permit comes through a Michigan school. See the state youth employment page. You get no refund of the course fee if you fail the course.
